caption:
Same loan, different year. 🏠

Freddie Mac's weekly survey had the 30-year fixed at 7.18% on Nov. 5. A year earlier it was 6.22%.

It's the third straight weekly drop, but still about a point higher than last year.

Are you waiting on rates or buying anyway?
